capabilities: Renders fenced sfl code blocks as interactive diagrams
Pans, zooms and selects shapes on the canvas
Edits SFL source with live preview and save-back
Changes diagrams via the SFL palette or canvas gestures
Falls back to static SVG on mobile and export
extras: Mobile, export, print and PDF fall back to a static SVG tier; the Expand modal is a view-only snapshot with no write-back. The README also documents an optional LLM round-trip via the Local REST API plugin's MCP server, which it explicitly says is unrelated to this plugin.
motivation: The author wanted diagrams to stay as plain text inside the note itself, so they move, rename and version-control with the note and never drift out of sync.
problem: Diagrams usually live outside notes as screenshots or separate whiteboard tabs, so they go stale and drift out of sync with the note's text.
summary: Diagram plugin that renders fenced sfl code blocks as live, interactive diagrams you can pan, zoom and edit in place.
